# IzignaMx Apps
> Professional Shopify apps built by IzignaMx, a Mexican software agency. Multi-channel inventory sync, price protection, AI-powered suggestions, and more.

## Apps
- [OmniSync](https://apps.izignamx.com/): Multi-channel inventory sync with price protection for Shopify. Sync across Mercado Libre, WhatsApp Business, Amazon, and Instagram.
- [OmniSync Odoo](https://apps.izignamx.com/): Bidirectional inventory, product, and order sync with Odoo ERP.
- [OmniSync BigCommerce](https://apps.izignamx.com/): Multi-channel sync with price protection for BigCommerce.
- [OmniSync WooCommerce](https://apps.izignamx.com/): WooCommerce marketplace and sales channel integration.

## Documentation
- [Getting Started](https://apps.izignamx.com/docs/omnisync/getting-started): Install OmniSync and configure your first channel in under 5 minutes.
- [API Reference](https://apps.izignamx.com/docs/omnisync/api): OmniSync REST API — 54+ endpoints across 21 groups for inventory sync, price management, and channel configuration.
- [Pricing](https://apps.izignamx.com/docs/omnisync/pricing): Plans from free trial ($0) to Enterprise ($59.99/mo). Compare features, limits, and sync intervals.
- [FAQ](https://apps.izignamx.com/docs/omnisync/faq): Frequently asked questions about installation, pricing, and technical usage.
- [Changelog](https://apps.izignamx.com/docs/omnisync/changelog): Release history — 585+ automated tests, 15 data models, AES-256-GCM encryption.
- [Guides](https://apps.izignamx.com/docs/omnisync/guides): Advanced workflows — price protection, multi-currency, channel integration, webhooks.

## Key Facts
- 4 supported channels: Mercado Libre, WhatsApp Business, Amazon, Instagram Shopping
- 585+ automated tests with 1,395+ assertions
- 54+ REST API endpoints across 21 groups
- AES-256-GCM credential encryption
- HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures
- Plans from $0 (14-day trial) to $59.99/mo (Enterprise)
- Built by IzignaMx — Mexican software agency
